jobDescription: The industrial drives business makes variable-speed drives for pumps, fans and conveyors, and their firmware controls the motor and the safety functions. The Senior Firmware Engineer is the senior engineer of record on drive firmware releases: signs the firmware release review and the safety function test report, leads the firmware design for a drive family, reviews the other engineers' firmware changes, and documents each release's limitations. An accredited engineering degree in electrical, electronic or control engineering and at least seven years of embedded firmware engineering are required, because the senior engineer signs the safety test report. Reports to the head of drive firmware; works with the hardware team, the functional safety engineer and the product line managers.
requirements: Holds an accredited engineering degree in electrical, electronic or control engineering.
At least seven years of embedded firmware engineering.
Has signed firmware release reviews and safety function test reports as senior engineer of record.
Leads the firmware design for a drive family and reviews other engineers' firmware changes under a documented review process.
Documents each release's limitations and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Senior Firmware Engineer and senior engineer of record for the mid-range drive family at an industrial drives maker since 2021, signing the firmware release reviews and the safety function test reports for the family's nine releases; firmware engineer at the same company from 2015 to 2021; ten years of embedded firmware engineering in all.
Education: MEng (master's degree in Electrical and Electronic Engineering), 2015, from an accredited programme; the degree certificate and the accreditation statement are attached.

Led the firmware design for the mid-range family's motor control and safety function modules and reviewed the four other firmware engineers' changes under the firmware review process, with the review records in the firmware repository.
Wrote the release limitation note and the hand-over conditions for each of the nine releases, filed with the release review.
Signed the safety function test reports jointly with the functional safety engineer, as the safety process requires for the drive family.

Work sample: two signed firmware release reviews, one signed safety function test report, one release limitation note and the degree certificate with the accreditation statement, with the firmware repository references as a verification trail.

Recruiter screen: candidate said she has signed the mid-range family's release reviews and safety test reports since 2021, holds an accredited MEng, and has been in firmware at the company since 2015; the split she gave matches the resume.
Hiring manager pre-read: the head of drive firmware asks the packet to cite the signed reviews and test reports and the accreditation statement, and to give the years by role.
